record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: For flat or curved Friedmann-Robertson-Walker universes governed by the full first-order corrected string action with the dilaton term and its coupling to higher-order curvature terms included, what are the relevant asymptotic regimes and stability properties, especially for the vacuum solutions of this effective string theory?

evidence.quote:
3.1 Asymptotics of gravi-dilaton ﬂat FRW cosmologies
The plan in this project is to extend relevant asymptotic analysis and stability results ... to the case of the full action (3.1), that is including the dilaton term and its coupling to the higher-order curvature terms. This will provide especially important results for the stability of the vacuum in this eﬀective string theory.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a four-dimensional spatially flat or spatially curved Friedmann–Robertson–Walker spacetime with metric
   ds^2 = -dt^2 + a(t)^2 \gamma_{ij} dx^i dx^j,
where \gamma_{ij} is the metric of a maximally symmetric 3-space of constant curvature k \in \{-1,0,+1\}, together with a scalar dilaton field \phi(t). Take the bosonic string effective action including the leading first-order \alpha' correction:
   S = \frac{1}{2\lambda_s^2} \int d^4x \sqrt{-g}\, e^{-\phi}\Bigl[ R + (\nabla\phi)^2 + \alpha' \bigl( c_1 R_{GB}^2 + c_2 (\nabla\phi)^4 + c_3 R^{\mu\nu}\nabla_\mu\phi\nabla_\nu\phi + \dots\bigr)\Bigr],
where R_{GB}^2 = R^2 - 4 R_{\mu\nu}R^{\mu\nu} + R_{\mu\nu\rho\sigma}R^{\mu\nu\rho\sigma} is the Gauss–Bonnet term, and the higher-derivative dilaton-curvature couplings are those required by string-frame field redefinition invariance at order \alpha'.

Reducing the equations of motion to an autonomous dynamical system for (H(t), \dot\phi(t), k/a^2(t)) (with H = \dot a/a):

(a) Identify all asymptotic regimes (fixed points, scaling solutions, and behavior as t \to \pm\infty) of this dynamical system, both in the flat (k=0) and curved (k = \pm 1) cases.

(b) Determine the linear stability of each such asymptotic regime, and in particular establish the stability properties of the perturbative string vacuum (H \to 0, \dot\phi \to const, a \to const) as a solution of the full \alpha'-corrected gravi-dilaton equations.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made: recent work based on the Hohm–Zwiebach all-order α' action constructs non-singular gravi-dilaton FRW solutions with regular bounces and asymptotic pre-big-bang behavior, and there are stability analyses of de Sitter and FLRW vacua arising from α' corrections. However, a complete classification of asymptotic regimes and stability for the full first-order α'-corrected dilaton-coupled action in both flat and curved FRW cases does not appear to be established in the literature, so the problem is best regarded as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: From the string vacuum to FLRW or de Sitter via α' corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Isotropic background geometries asymptotically evolving from the string perturbative vacuum, with α' corrections producing regular bounces.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work analyzes asymptotics from the string vacuum under α' corrections.

status_evidence.title: Non-singular pre-big bang scenarios from all-order α' corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Based on the Hohm-Zwiebach action, non-singular non-perturbative cosmological solutions with complete α' corrections for the bosonic gravi-dilaton system.
status_evidence.claim: Non-singular gravi-dilaton FRW solutions with α' corrections have been constructed, addressing part of the asymptotic problem.
